title: 雨夜桥头
logline: 雨夜，她撑着油纸伞站在木桥上，等一个不会来的人。

scenes.visual: rainy night, wet wooden bridge, a woman holding an oil-paper umbrella
scenes.action: she looks down at the river, unmoving

scenes.visual: close-up on the umbrella edge, raindrops sliding off
scenes.action: her hand tightens around the handle

scenes.visual: the bridge from a distance, one small figure under the umbrella
scenes.action: she turns and walks away slowly
